    marker_vals = set(input_grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if input_grid[r][c] != 0 and input_grid[r][c] != 2)
    marker_val = list(marker_vals)[0] if marker_vals else None
    
    # Pattern columns: ceil(width/2) columns starting from col_min with step 2
    num_pattern_cols = (width + 1) // 2
    pattern_cols = [col_min + 2 * i for i in range(num_pattern_cols)]
